episode_summary: In this episode, Bobby Kerr discusses the critical importance of optimizing Google Business Profiles for real estate agents. He provides actionable insights on creating hyper-local content, managing reviews, and leveraging AI to enhance visibility and lead generation. The episode emphasizes the shift from generic content to specific, community-focused strategies to stand out in search results.
